clips.title: The story
paras: Supplies from Darkshire is an Alliance quest in Duskwood where the hermit Abercrombie asks passing travelers to run an errand to Darkshire on his behalf. Claiming to be too frail to make the dangerous trek through the haunted forest, he seeks a rare material known as Ghost Hair Thread from Madame Eva.

Isolated in a shack north of Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood, the hermit Abercrombie cuts a pitiful figure. When approached by travelers, he laments his old age and frail body, claiming he cannot survive the journey through the woods to purchase goods from Darkshire. His requested errand appears simple: travel back to the township's town square and speak with Madame Eva to procure a spool of Ghost Hair Thread.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, what is a poor old man to do? I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.
Can you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread? You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Ghost Hair Thread is what you need, is it? I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.
